fields.label: Enable Costing and Pricing
fields.description: Shows the Costing sheet with Sale Value, VAT, Tax, Difference Value (profit) and Total Quoted Value on Quotation, and the same pricing summary on Sales Order.

fields.label: Show Additional Items
fields.description: Shows the Additional Items table on Quotation.

fields.label: Show Vehicle Item
fields.description: Shows the Vehicle Type field on Lead, Opportunity, Quotation and Sales Order.

fields.label: Show Job Item
fields.description: Shows the Job Item field on Lead, Opportunity, Quotation and Sales Order.

fields.label: Show Project and Revision Details
fields.description: Shows Project, Estimator and Revision fields on Quotation.

fields.label: Finished Item Group
fields.description: Item group used to filter Vehicle, Job and Finished Item links. Leave blank to use the default in Jagadamba Settings.
